mutants.description: drop the expiry compare of the session token
mutants.behaviour: a session cookie copied from a browser keeps signing its holder in after it has expired
mutants.find: if (typeof body.exp !== 'number' || body.exp * 1000 < now) return null

mutants.description: accept a session token whose HMAC does not verify
mutants.behaviour: anyone can write a cookie for any address and be signed in as that person, with no secret

mutants.description: POST /verify no longer refuses a sign-in code past its expiry
mutants.behaviour: a six-digit code found in an old mail still signs in, long after its window closed

mutants.description: POST /verify no longer stops after MAX_ATTEMPTS wrong codes
mutants.behaviour: an attacker can keep guessing the six digits of one code until one matches

mutants.description: pgIdentityStore.approveLink no longer requires the round to be pending
mutants.behaviour: a second browser holding the same link overwrites the address of a round already approved, so the device is signed in as somebody else
mutants.find:
status = 'approved', approved_at = now()
         where nonce_hash = $1 and status = 'pending' and expires_at > now()`
mutants.replace:
status = 'approved', approved_at = now()
         where nonce_hash = $1 and expires_at > now()`

mutants.description: pgIdentityStore.approveLink no longer requires the round to be unexpired
mutants.behaviour: a sign-in link opened after its window still approves the round
mutants.find:
status = 'approved', approved_at = now()
         where nonce_hash = $1 and status = 'pending' and expires_at > now()`
mutants.replace:
status = 'approved', approved_at = now()
         where nonce_hash = $1 and status = 'pending'`

mutants.description: POST /auth/link/:nonce/exchange no longer compares the client secret
mutants.behaviour: whoever sees the nonce (it travels in a URL) collects the approved address without the secret only the lane holds

mutants.description: POST /auth/link/:nonce/exchange no longer requires the round to be approved
mutants.behaviour: a lane is answered for a round nobody approved in a browser

mutants.description: POST /auth/link/:nonce/exchange no longer refuses a round past its expiry
mutants.behaviour: an approved round that was never collected can be exchanged after its window closed

mutants.description: the door that changes a role or removes a seat no longer requires the caller to be an Owner

mutants.find:
an Owner's acts only.

an Owner's acts only.

mutants.description: removing a seat no longer refuses the last Owner of a site
mutants.behaviour: a site is left with no Owner: nobody can manage its team any more
